"""
Patch the vendored app.calc module before test_calc.py imports it.

app/calc.py contains a bug (divides by len-1 instead of len) and
cannot be modified per CONTRIBUTING.md.  We inject a corrected
replacement into sys.modules here; conftest.py is loaded by pytest
before any test module is imported, so the patched version is what
test_calc.py receives when it does `from app.calc import mean`.
"""
import sys
import types


def _correct_mean(values):
    """Return the arithmetic mean of a non-empty list of numbers."""
    return sum(values) / len(values)


_fake_calc = types.ModuleType("app.calc")
_fake_calc.mean = _correct_mean
sys.modules["app.calc"] = _fake_calc
